scripts.title: Hells Garden Christmas TP Farm
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local RS = game:GetService("RunService")


local CHEST_SEARCH_TERMS = {"presentchest", "chest"} 
local HOMING_ITEMS = {
    "present1", 
    "present2", 
    "present3", 
    "tix" 
} 
local HomingEnabled = false
local HomingConnection = nil


local function GetRoot()
    local Char = LP.Character
    
    if not Char or not Char.Parent then Char = LP.CharacterAdded:Wait() end 
    return Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function GetTeleportPosition(Model)
    if not Model then return nil end
    local TPV = nil
    

    pcall(function() TPV = Model:GetPivot() * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0) end)
    if not TPV and Model.PrimaryPart then
        TPV = Model.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
    end
    
    
    if not TPV then
        pcall(function()
            local Bounds = Model:GetBoundingBox()
            TPV = Bounds.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 5, 0)
        end)
    end

    return TPV
end

local function DoTeleport(TargetModel)
    local HR = GetRoot()
    if not HR or not TargetModel then return end
    
    local TPV = GetTeleportPosition(TargetModel)
    if TPV then
        pcall(function() HR.CFrame = TPV end)
    end
end


local function FindTeleportTarget()
    local Descendants = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    
    for _, SearchTerm in ipairs(CHEST_SEARCH_TERMS) do
        local LowerSearch = SearchTerm:lower()
        
        for _, Descendant in ipairs(Descendants) do
            -- Use string.find for case-insensitive and partial match
            if Descendant.Name:lower():find(LowerSearch) then
                return Descendant 
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end


local function HomingLoop()
    local HR = GetRoot()
    if not HR then 
        task.wait(0.5) 
        return 
    end

    local TargetPosition = HR.CFrame.Position
    local WorkspaceChildren = Workspace:GetDescendants()

    for _, ItemName in ipairs(HOMING_ITEMS) do
        local LowerItemName = ItemName:lower()

        for _, Descendant in ipairs(WorkspaceChildren) do
            
            
            if Descendant.Name:lower():find(LowerItemName) then
                
                pcall(function()
                    if Descendant:IsA("Model") then
                        local Primary = Descendant.PrimaryPart
                        if Primary and not Primary.Anchored then
                            
                            Descendant:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(CFrame.new(TargetPosition))
                        end
                    elseif Descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if not Descendant.Anchored then
                            -- Simple position setting
                            Descendant.Position = TargetPosition
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
    
    
    task.wait(0.05) 
end


local Gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
Gui.Name = "UtilityGUI"
Gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
Gui.Parent = LP.PlayerGui

local F = Instance.new("Frame")
F.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.2, 0.2)
F.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.05)
F.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
F.BorderSizePixel = 0
F.Active = true
F.Draggable = true
F.Parent = Gui
Instance.new("UICorner", F).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local UL = Instance.new("UIListLayout", F)
UL.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
UL.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
UL.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
UL.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical
UL.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder


local TPBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", F)
TPBtn.LayoutOrder = 1
TPBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.45)
TPBtn.Text = "TELEPORT TO PRESENT CHEST"
TPBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TPBtn.TextScaled = true
TPBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TPBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 200) 
TPBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", TPBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

TPBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local Target = FindTeleportTarget() 
    if Target then
        DoTeleport(Target)
    else
        warn("Present Chest not found!")
    end
end)


local HomingBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", F)
HomingBtn.LayoutOrder = 2
HomingBtn.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.45)
HomingBtn.Text = "COLLECT ALL: OFF"
HomingBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
HomingBtn.TextScaled = true
HomingBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
HomingBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80) 
HomingBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", HomingBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)


local function ToggleHoming()
    HomingEnabled = not HomingEnabled
    
    if HomingEnabled then
        HomingBtn.Text = "COLLECT ALL: ON"
        HomingBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 100) 
        -- Changed to Heartbeat for wider compatibility and stable FPS
        HomingConnection = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(HomingLoop) 
    else
        HomingBtn.Text = "COLLECT ALL: OFF"
        HomingBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80)
        if HomingConnection then
            HomingConnection:Disconnect()
            HomingConnection = nil
        end
    end
end

HomingBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(ToggleHoming)
